item.title: Truck, SUV crash causes delays on Route 6 in Wellfleet
item.description: WELLFLEET – A traffic collision between a garbage truck and a SUV caused delays for a time on Route 6 in Wellfleet. The crash happened about 11:45 AM Thursday by Aaron Rich Road. No serious injuries were reported. Wellfleet Police are investigating. Photos by AAP/CWN The post Truck, SUV crash causes delays on Route 6 in Wellfleet appeared first on CapeCod.com.

item.title: Firefighters quickly douse basement fire in Falmouth
item.description: FALMOUTH – Firefighters were able to quickly get a basement fire under control in Falmouth. Crews responded to 29 Lawrence Street around 11:45 AM Friday. No injuries were reported. Road closures were reported in the area due to hose lines in the street. Further details were not immediately available.
